ns2:course.label: Reactor Theory II
ns2:course.description: Advanced treatment of the theory of slow-neutron scattering, neutron thermalization, Doppler broadening, fuel depletion and fuel loadings, properties of neutron migration operators, and mathematical neutron transport theory; interpretation of related experiments; advanced topics. Same as PHYS 521. Prerequisite: NPRE 521 and NPRE 555 (both waived for Physics majors).
